name: Camping Walchensee
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Walchensee is situated directly on scenic Lake Walchensee. Celebrated for its crystal-clear alpine water, the lake provides superb swimming opportunities. The grounds offer pitches with panoramic lake and mountain vistas, along with an on-site bathing beach and boat rental. Watersports and fishing are popular summer pastimes, complemented by nearby hiking and cycle paths.
